title: Booking-Delay Allowance When a Kessler Care Fleet Plan Changes Units
content:
**Allowance.** When a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans is moved onto a replacement unit, the booking-delay allowance adds miles to its re-based expiration odometer. The allowance depends on the span in calendar days from the replacement's delivery date to the day the move is recorded. The delivery date is the one on the customer's Kessler Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement standing in closed status in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records.

| Calendar days from delivery to the move | Booking-delay allowance |
|---|---|
| More than 60 | 2000 miles |
| More than 30, up to and including 60 | 1000 miles |
| 30 or fewer | None |

| Hypothetical span | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 30 days | none |
| 31 days | 1000 miles |
| 60 days | 1000 miles |
| 61 days | 2000 miles |
